Urgent and same-day cover

Short-staffed today? Call us now.

Sickness, no-shows and sudden admissions happen with no warning. For a gap in the next 24 hours, phone us. We can start looking as soon as we have the details.

Call 020 3488 8172 Send a request

The line is answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including bank holidays.

Have this ready when you call

  • The role: nurse, HCA, senior carer or support worker
  • Start and finish time
  • Service address and postcode
  • Key skills, for example hoist, PEG or positive behaviour support
  • Who the worker reports to on arrival
The service

Who it is for and what it covers.

Included

  • Cover starting today or tomorrow
  • Day shifts, nights, long days, sleep-ins and waking nights
  • Nurses, healthcare assistants, senior carers and support workers
  • Care homes, nursing homes, supported living and mental health services

Not included

  • A guarantee that every urgent shift can be filled
  • Workers who do not meet the checks for your setting, however urgent
  • Doctors, therapists and other professions we do not supply
How it works

From your call to staff at the door.

  1. You call

    We take the details and agree the rate for the shift.

  2. We contact workers

    We start with people near you who have worked in your type of service.

  3. We call you back

    With a name and an arrival time, or an honest update if the shift is proving hard to fill.

  4. The worker arrives

    They report to the person you named. They arrive in uniform.

Cost and timing

What affects urgent cover.

Hours of notice

The more notice you give, the more people we can ask. Call as soon as you know.

Time and day

Nights, weekends and bank holidays are charged at higher rates.

Role and skills

Nurses and specialist skills are in shorter supply than general care roles.

Urgent does not mean fewer checks. Every worker we send has passed the same checks as a planned booking: right to work, criminal record, references and training. See how we check staff.

Fewer emergencies

Stop the same gaps coming back.

Most urgent calls come from the same shifts each month. Block book regular workers for the shifts that keep falling through.

Set up block bookings
Can you always fill an urgent shift?

No agency can promise that. We will tell you early and honestly how the search is going, so you can make other plans if you need to.

Do urgent shifts cost more?

Short-notice, night and bank holiday shifts are usually charged at a higher rate. We confirm the rate before the booking is made.

Do I need an account first?

We need written terms with you before we supply anyone. If you are new, we can agree them quickly by email while we start the search.

Need someone today?

Phone is fastest for urgent cover.
